Europe PMC core record for PMID 29113996 (MeSH: Animals, Newborn; Rats, Wistar; Insulin-Secreting Cells; Glucose)
https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2017/11/PXD007689/<all 63 *.raw> (HTTP range read, first 64 KB each; instrument model, original file name, method name)

claims.location: comment[label] / factor value[sampling time] / characteristics[sampling time], all rows
claims.value: iTRAQ114=0 minute, iTRAQ115=5 minute, iTRAQ116=10 minute, iTRAQ117=15 minute
claims.evidence: Methods: 'Two biological replicates were made and labeling was performed as follows: control 114, 5 min glucose 115, 10 min glucose 116, and 15 min glucose 117.' Merged.tsv reporter columns are Ion_114-Ion_117 (4-plex).

claims.value: 1 for *_R1_* files (128 rows), 2 for *_R2_* files (124 rows)
claims.evidence: Methods state two biological replicates; file names carry R1/R2.
Methods: islets isolated from Wistar rat pups; mouse in PRIDE organisms is only the search database.
'4 to 5-days-old Wistar rat pups (Taconic, NY)'; MeSH Rats, Wistar.
Pups 4-5 days old at isolation; MeSH Animals, Newborn; EFO:0001372.
Sex not reported in Methods or MeSH.
Islets from healthy pups; PRIDE diseases empty.

claims.value: glucose / 20 mM on 5,10,15 min rows; not applicable on 0 min rows
claims.evidence: Stimulated with 20 mM glucose; Fig. 1 legend: 'nontreated islets served as control'.

claims.value: not applicable (Nonmodification_*), enrichment of phosphorylated protein (Phosphoryation_*), enrichment of glycopeptides (Sialylation_*)
claims.evidence: Modified TiSH protocol: TiO2 flow-through = nonmodified; TiO2/SIMAC phosphopeptides; formerly sialylated N-glycopeptides. Glycopeptide value is free text (no EFO/PRIDE term).

claims.value: Q Exactive HF (MS:1002523) for QHF* files; Orbitrap Fusion (MS:1002416) for FUS* files
claims.evidence: All 63 RAW headers: 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS' or 'Orbitrap Fusion'; original acquisition names equal deposited names.

claims.value: HILIC (PRIDE:0000554) except Phosphoryation_R1_QHF0903 and Phosphoryation_R2_QHF0904 (not applicable); fractions restart at 1 within each replicate and peptide group in run order (nonmodified 1-11, monophospho 1-13, glyco 1-7/1-6; QHF0903/0904 = 1); peptide group appended to source name
claims.evidence: Methods: mono-phospho, deglycosylated and nonmodified peptides HILIC-fractionated; multi-phosphopeptides analysed directly. RAW header sample names and autosampler wells confirm fraction order and the QHF0903/0904 multi-phospho runs.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C Fixed; iTRAQ4plex K Variable; iTRAQ4plex Any N-term Variable; Oxidation M Variable; Phospho S,T,Y Variable; Deamidated N,Q Variable on Sialylation rows only
claims.evidence: SearchModification elements; iTRAQ fixedMod=false in all three mzids; Deamidated only in the sialylation search; +0.984 in 536/993 sampled sialylation PSMs.
Methods: Lys-C predigestion 2 h then trypsin (Promega) overnight; Fig. 1 legend 'digested using Lys-C and trypsin'; mzid enzyme Trypsin.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance] / comment[fragment mass tolerance]
claims.evidence: mzid ParentTolerance +/-20 ppm (paper text says 10 ppm; deposited search used). No explicit fragment tolerance in MS-GF+ (HighRes instrument model).

claims.location: comment[dissociation method] / comment[ms2 mass analyzer] / comment[proteomics data acquisition method]
claims.evidence: Method names *_HCD30 / *_HCD40, Top-N DDA; Fusion method summary MS2 detector Orbitrap; paper MS2 at 30,000 FWHM; mzid FragmentMethod HCD.
Lysis buffer with 10 mM DTT; alkylated by 20 mM iodoacetamide.

limitations: Channel map comes from one sentence of the paper Methods; no deposited file names samples per channel.

HILIC fraction order confirmed by RAW headers: Fusion phospho/glyco sample names carry the fraction number (ISL02/ISL03 = replicate 1/2); nonmodified QHF runs follow rising autosampler wells. Nonmodified fraction numbers are ordinal positions (wells skip some positions).
QHF0903/QHF0904 confirmed by RAW header sample names ('Pia ISL02/ISL03 multiphospho', no fraction suffix) as the unfractionated multi-phosphopeptide runs.
Search modifications read from one mzid per peptide class, not all 63.
Pup sex and number of pups per pool not reported.
Supplementary tables and the paper PDF were not opened; Europe PMC full text and publisher site were inaccessible.
Collision energy not encoded (method names HCD30/HCD40 vs paper 32V).
PRM validation data are in Panorama Public, not this deposit, and were not annotated.
